description: This Java class 'EnumProcessor' is a helper for processing enum definitions within a code generation framework. It manages a collection of enum wrappers, analyzes their usage, and provides methods for code generation and lookup.

classes.name: EnumProcessor
classes.description: A helper class for processing enum definitions, managing enum wrappers, and assisting in code generation within a code generation framework.

methods.name: buildModel
methods.description: Creates an EnumProcessor instance and populates it with enum wrappers based on the provided ICService's enum definitions.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Performs analysis on the ICService object; currently a placeholder with no implementation.

methods.name: analyzeAgain
methods.description: Checks each enum wrapper to identify unused enums and prints warnings for those not referenced by events or IPC.

methods.name: getWrappers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all enum wrappers managed by this processor.

methods.name: getEnumForDefinitionName
methods.description: Retrieves the EnumDefWrapper associated with a given enum definition name.
